Onaje Allan Gumbs was born on September 3, 1949 in New York City. He attended the High School of Music and Art, and SUNY Fredonia, and quickly established himself as a composer and pianist after graduation. Onaje has worked with Norman Connors, Woody Shaw, and Nat Adderley, and he is currently active in the New York City music scene.
Onaje was interviewed in New York City on January 13, 2001, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming in New York City for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive and I’m pleased to have my old friend, Onaje Allan Gumbs with me today, who is a marvelous piano player and arranger and composer, and manages to make a life in music in New York City, which I think is saying something.
